summary: A handheld panning landscape shot sweeping across the formal hedges, central fountain, and strolling visitors at the Conservatory Garden in Central Park on a bright sunny afternoon.

people.description: Park visitors standing in small groups near the fountain and walking along paved pathways in casual daytime attire.

quality.issues: Sun flare and bright sun halo directly in frame

moments.action: Camera smoothly pans across ornate spiral boxwood hedges toward a fountain surrounded by visitors against the bright glowing sun
Camera continues panning past the fountain onto stone paved walkways and lush greenery under a clear blue sky
good_for: taking a walk to clear my head
